display.title: Episode 192: The Strange Visitor (Chai Elul)
display.summary_short: A Chai Elul show: 192 weeks on the air, a march to 'Sheyibaneh Beis HaMikdash', Shema with a young guest, and the story of the orphan Yisrolik and the stranger in the cave.
display.summary_long: Broadcast on 17 Elul 5745, the eve of Chai Elul. Uncle Yossi celebrates program number 192, nearly four years of songs, contests, Mitzvah Time and stories, and the classes who record the show to play in school. Back from summer vacation, he urges strong Elul resolutions and asks for the one wish that includes all others, Moshiach now, leading into a Hakochainik march to 'Sheyibaneh Beis HaMikdash' from Pirkei Avos. After sponsor messages, a young guest leads the Shema. For Chai Elul, the birthday of the Baal Shem Tov, story time tells of little Yisrolik, orphaned at five, who never forgot his father's last words: fear nothing and no one, only Hashem. He studies alone in a cave in the woods until a stranger with a white beard and shining eyes finds him, hears that he is not alone because Hashem is with him, and becomes his teacher. Uncle Yossi reveals that the boy grew up to be the Baal Shem Tov, notes that Chai Elul is also the Alter Rebbe's birthday, and announces the Tzivos Hashem Sukkos Experience on the first day of Chol HaMoed.
display.lesson: Fear only Hashem, and you are never alone; a birthday of a tzaddik is a special time to ask Hashem for blessings.
